key_terms.ضَعِيفٌ: Weak (a technical term in hadith sciences indicating a narrator's reliability is not strong)

ai.seo_question: Who is Ahmad ibn al-Qasim ibn Tar Khan and what is his status in Shia hadith sciences?
ai.summary: This is a biographical entry from the book 'Kitab al- Duafa' (The Book of Weak Narrators). It identifies Aḥmad ibn al-Qāsim ibn Ṭarkhān, known as Abū al-Sarrāj, and classifies his status as 'weak' (da'if) in terms of hadith narration reliability.
